sections.title: Roof repair contractor in Edinburg
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg, so most of our repair calls here are a short drive. We have repaired roofs across Hidalgo County since 2003. A leak or a damaged section does not always mean a new roof. Most of the time it is one specific, findable problem: cracked flashing, a patch of missing shingles, a failed pipe boot. That can usually be fixed in a single visit.

Edinburg homes range from older houses near downtown and along Closner Boulevard and McColl Road to newer subdivisions on the north side toward Trenton Road and Sugar Road. Older roofs tend to fail from age and worn flashing. Newer roofs are more often hit by hail or wind. We inspect first and tell you plainly whether it is a repair or something bigger.
A repair call is not a reason to sell you a new roof. If a repair is the right fix, that is what we recommend and what we do.

cards.title: Leak repair
cards.body: Ceiling stains, active drips, or damp insulation. We trace the leak to where water actually enters, which is often several feet from where it shows up inside, and repair it there.

cards.title: Storm and hail damage repair
cards.body: Missing or lifted shingles, granule loss, and impact damage from Hidalgo County storms. We document what we find in writing, which helps if you file an insurance claim.

cards.title: Flashing repair
cards.body: Flashing around chimneys, vents, and valleys is one of the most common leak sources on Edinburg homes. We reseal or replace failed flashing so water runs off the way it should.

cards.title: Shingle repair by section
cards.body: Cracked, curling, or wind torn shingles are replaced in the affected area and matched as closely as possible to your existing roof.

cards.title: Skylight and vent repair
cards.body: Failed skylight seals and vent boots are a common, specific leak source. We repair or reseal them without disturbing the rest of the roof.

cards.title: Inspections after storms
cards.body: A full walk of the roof after hail or high wind, with a written report on what needs repair now and what to keep an eye on.

sections.title: What causes most roof repairs in Edinburg
paras: Heat and constant sun wear down shingles faster here than in cooler parts of the country. Shingles that look fine from the street can already be brittle. In older neighborhoods near downtown, many repair calls start with a small ceiling stain that turns out to be failed flashing or a cracked vent boot that has been dripping slowly for a long time.

On the north side, in newer subdivisions, hail and wind are the more common cause. One storm can lift a section of shingles or dent the surface enough to let water in, and the homeowner needs both the repair and the paperwork for the insurance company.
If you want more detail, read our guide to roof repair in Edinburg and the RGV. If your roof is past repairing, see roof replacement in Edinburg.

faqs.q: I have a leak in my Edinburg home. Do I need a new roof?
faqs.a: Usually not. Most leaks come from a specific, fixable source such as flashing, a vent boot, or a section of damaged shingles, and can be repaired without replacing the whole roof. We inspect first and tell you plainly what we find. Call (956) 422-3335 to schedule an inspection.

faqs.q: How much does roof repair cost in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Most repairs run from a few hundred dollars to around $1,500, depending on what is wrong and how much of the roof is affected. We give a written estimate after inspecting and before any work starts, so you know the number before you commit.

faqs.q: How fast can you get to my roof in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Our office is in Edinburg, so we can usually schedule an inspection quickly, especially after a storm. Most repairs are finished in one visit once we know what is failing.

faqs.q: Can you document storm damage for my insurance claim?
faqs.a: Yes. We inspect the roof and give you written documentation of what we find, which helps when you file with your insurance company. We are not a public adjuster, but we can walk you through exactly what we observed.

faqs.q: How do I get a roof repair estimate in Edinburg?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We schedule a time to look at the roof and give you a written estimate. Estimates are free with no obligation.
